description: This file contains firmware functions for CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) operations on STM32F10x microcontrollers, including functions to reset, calculate, and retrieve CRC values, as well as to set and get the independent data register.

methods.name: CRC_CalcCRC
methods.description: Calculates the 32-bit CRC of a single data word.

methods.name: CRC_CalcBlockCRC
methods.description: Calculates the 32-bit CRC of a buffer of data words.

methods.name: CRC_SetIDRegister
methods.description: Stores an 8-bit value in the Independent Data register.

methods.name: CRC_GetIDRegister
methods.description: Returns the 8-bit value stored in the Independent Data register.
